name: Classic Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes with crisp edges and a soft center.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk in the milk, egg, and melted butter until just combined; a few small lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly buttered skillet over medium heat.
Pour about 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook until bubbles form on top and the edges look set.
Flip and cook the other side until golden, then serve warm.

name: Avocado Egg Toast
description: Creamy avocado, a fried egg, and crisp toast.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Toast the sourdough slices until crisp.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and cook the eggs to your preferred doneness.
Spread the avocado over the toast and top each slice with an egg.
Finish with red pepper flakes and serve immediately.

name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
description: Layers of yogurt, berries, and crunchy granola.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Spoon half of the Greek yogurt into two glasses.
Add half of the mixed berries and granola to each glass.
Repeat with the remaining yogurt, berries, and granola.
Drizzle each parfait with honey.
Serve immediately or chill until ready to eat.

name: Breakfast Burrito
description: A warm tortilla packed with eggs, beans, cheese, and salsa.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Heat the black beans in a skillet until hot and season with salt and pepper.
Whisk the eggs and scramble them in a lightly oiled skillet until just set.
Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry skillet.
Layer eggs, black beans, cheddar, and salsa down the center of each tortilla.
Fold in the sides, roll tightly, and serve warm.

name: Banana Oatmeal
description: Creamy oats cooked with banana and cinnamon.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Combine the oats, milk or water, cinnamon, and salt in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy.
Slice the banana and arrange it over the oatmeal.
Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs gently cooked in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Cook diced onion and bell pepper in olive oil until softened.
Add garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Make four wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook until the whites are set.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Grilled chicken, romaine, parmesan, and Caesar dressing in a soft wrap.
creator: Community Cooks

name: Tomato Soup & Grilled Cheese

creator: Community Cooks

Butter the bread, add cheddar between the slices, and cook in a skillet until golden on both sides and melted inside.

Stir in the diced tomato, red onion, cilantro, and salt.

name: Mango Lassi

creator: Community Cooks
steps: Peel and dice the mango, reserving a few pieces for garnish.
Blend the mango, yogurt, milk, and honey until completely smooth.
Add a small pinch of cardamom if desired and blend briefly.
Pour the lassi into chilled glasses.
Garnish with mango pieces and serve cold.

name: Iced Matcha Latte
description: Earthy matcha shaken with milk and served over ice.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Whisk the matcha powder with a small amount of cool water until smooth.
Fill a glass with ice.
Pour in the milk and gently stir.
Add the prepared matcha and stir until evenly combined.
Serve immediately.

name: Strawberry Lemonade
description: Fresh strawberries blended with bright lemon and cold water.
creator: Community Cooks

Stir in the sugar until dissolved.
Fill glasses with ice and pour in the strawberry lemonade.
Garnish with a lemon slice and serve cold.

name: Mint Lime Cooler
description: A bright lime drink with fresh mint and sparkling water.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Juice the lime and lightly bruise the mint leaves to release their aroma.
Combine the lime juice, mint, water, and sweetener in a pitcher.
Stir until the sweetener dissolves.
Fill glasses with ice and pour over the mint-lime mixture.
Garnish with fresh mint and lime slices and serve cold.

name: Cold Brew Latte
description: Cold brew coffee balanced with creamy milk over ice.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Brew the coffee using your preferred method and let it cool completely.
Fill a glass with ice.
Pour the cold coffee over the ice.
Add the milk and stir until evenly mixed.
Serve immediately.

name: Peach Iced Tea

creator: Community Cooks

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
